Additionally fleet_rollout has no production caller — no config driver applies pending nodes or reports health. Holds: pinned revision enforced on apply, unhealthy report pauses and empties pending, per-node rollback state exposed, full pinned+healthy fleet completes (vc_201_068_mastery_pin_pause_rollback_state_and_completion_hold).
